overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a single joint notice for the Board and Planning Board meeting satisfied G.L. c. 30A, § 20(b) and the matter was closed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's December 13, 2011 joint meeting with the Planning Board was illegal because the Board failed to post notice of it.
allegations.key_passage: The joint notice included both Boards' names, the date, time, and location of the meeting, and included all of the topics that the two Boards anticipated discussing.
